name: auth-failure
description: A rejected API token. The Basic header is built from token-as-username, so a bad token answers 401 on the first assets request. Proves the run ends with a printed diagnostic and a clean zero-asset return instead of aborting, and that the 401 is not retried (it is not in get_json's transient status list). The pinned request count is the assertion that no findings walk was attempted with a dead credential.

log_contains: bitsight: failed to retrieve assets: status 401
